binding_rule: two-stage: pre-freeze purpose/expected -> implement -> fill the real argv/cwd/interpreter -> bound. Every command below is bound with the real argv it was run with; raw return codes are recorded in runs[].raw_returncode.
interpreter: <attempt>\iso\venv\Scripts\python.exe  (CPython 3.13.9, Anaconda-packaged; iso/venv is the ONLY interpreter allowed)
cwd_convention: <attempt> unless stated; product code is imported only from <attempt>\iso\rf\scripts (isolated copy)
card_commands: the card states: 命令： 本卡无产品执行命令；仅设计与独立审查。 The commands below are this attempt's own read-only probes, not product commands.

commands.purpose: the formal evidence run: 12 cases (P-D1 output fault, P-D2 markdown fault, registry fault attempt, stdout-only, validate-only, same-request x2, as_of-only-differs x2, two mutants, snapshot) driven through the REAL CLI as a real child process per publication, each read back by a SEPARATE reader process; plus the proposed-identity falsifier and a two-process concurrency burst
commands.expected_business_result: PROBE_OK; all 12 cases recorded with producer rc, registry line counts, member existence and the reader's consumer-visible state; identity falsifier reports publication_id_differ=true for the as_of-only pair
commands.fault_injection_method: REAL filesystem faults only (a directory placed where a file must be written -> real WinError 5); the production modules are never monkeypatched

runs.note: HARNESS DEFECT: the producer snippet did not pass the positional input-file argument, so cases c01-c10 all exited 2 with an argparse usage message and measured nothing. Preserved as after/probe_commit.attempt1_argv_bug.*
argv fixed; 12 cases ran. Case c04's registry-fault injection turned out to be a fail-open (registry_file() treats a directory env value as a root) - see I09A-c5

commands.purpose: close the c04 gap with a GENUINE unreachable-registry fault, and explain the path-as-directory artefact
commands.expected_business_result: case a: registry_file() resolves the directory env value to a NESTED publications.jsonl and the append SUCCEEDS (producer rc=0) -> fail-open; case b: with a real ACL deny (icacls /deny <user>:(WD,AD)) on the registry directory the producer exits 2, no output file is written and the registry has 0 lines -> fail-closed
commands.recovery_performed: the ACL deny was removed in the child's finally block and independently re-checked with icacls (no DENY lines remain)

runs.note: HARNESS DEFECTS: ASDIR_CODE missed `import json`; the icacls output contains non-UTF-8 bytes so a text decode raised, and because that happened before the try block the ACL deny was NOT auto-reverted. Fixed by (a) importing json, (b) errors='replace' on the subprocess decodes; the leftover DENY was removed manually with icacls /remove:d and verified
both cases measured; ACL verified clean afterwards

commands.purpose: produce the human-readable case table and identity/concurrency section from the raw report (no measurement of its own)
commands.expected_business_result: after/probe_summary.stdout.txt with one block per case, the identity contract block, the concurrency block and the read-only production registry fingerprint

commands.purpose: INDEPENDENT channel (PowerShell, not the Python code path) re-computation of the production registry facts the oracle freezes: line count, validation_status presence, artifact_type distribution, artifact_id nulls, the full line+chain hash verification, and the multiplicity of the (input,result,engine,schema,artifact_type) groups
argv: pwsh-free: Get-Content -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json + System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256 over json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
commands.expected_business_result: 60 entries; 57 with validation_status / 3 without; forecast 57 / snapshot 3; 1 non-null artifact_id / 57 null; hash_or_chain_problems=0; 31 groups, 21 with count>1, max 6; last line_sha256=61fbec623b2a641b9b69555c3eae4e5b64b63697a05877ed95510d73d87ce67f
before_after_evidence: before/baseline_hashes.txt (production registry sha256 before and after: identical)
commands.capability_limit: this channel performs ARITHMETIC on bytes (parse/count/hash); it does not validate the semantics of the commit protocol, and it is not a substitute for the reader-process evidence

commands.expected_business_result: before/git_status_before.txt (63 M + 79 ?? = 142 real entries), before/git_status_cw_before.txt (2), before/git_status_ff_before.txt (1)

commands_not_executed.reason: the card states it has no product command (命令： 本卡无产品执行命令；仅设计与独立审查). T-PUB belongs to I-09-B/C, whose test nodeids do not exist yet, so no nodeid may be guessed here.
real process termination / power-loss / repeated-recovery semantics are card I-09-C scope; this card must not claim them.
the protocol selects a registry commit lock, but implementing and stress-testing it is I-09-B scope; the single concurrency burst recorded here (2 workers, one run) is NOT a lock test.
